text: {"assertions":["A missed run bug in the scheduler was identified and fixed in worker/scheduler/cron.py on 2026-01-20.","The missed run bug only occurred for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels of nesting.","The bug manifested as a slot with no execution record.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation in the background jobs code.","The fix involved prefetching the lazy relation in a single query, implemented in PR #2780 on branch fix/missed-run-1.","The bug was reproduced by advancing the fake clock across the schedule.","After the fix was applied, the alert stayed silent for 28 consecutive days, confirming the issue was resolved."]}
